<function name="SetGoalToneMappingScale" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Sets the goal HDR tone mapping scale.

Use this in a rendering/think hook as it is reset every frame.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="scale" type="number">The target scale.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
